contentText:
Soon, James Gunn and Peter Safran will no longer head up Skydance's DC Studios. After taking the helm of DC Studios as co-CEOs in 2022 , Gunn and Safran are being replaced by former Marvel SVP of Production and Development Jeremy Latcham, Deadline reports .

However, Gunn and Safran will "continue to produce on various DC projects" and are still working on the Superman followup Man of Tomorrow , Deadline says. Gunn also posted on Instagram that he and Safran have "just been engaged on another DC project which I'm writing."
